svg.title: Which address the account name resolves to
svg.desc: While the lab is peered, a tunnel client that uses the tunnel's DNS resolves the …blob account through the private DNS zone privatelink.blob.core.windows.net, linked to vnet-lab and the gateway VNet, to the private endpoint's address and reaches the account over the peering. Unpeered, or from outside the tunnel, the name resolves to a public address, which works only while public network access is on.
